purpose: Teach: フルタイム/所以/独禁法/両氏/所収/インタラクティブ/送受信/キャッチフレーズ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: フルタイム勤務希望者を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check in on the full-time job applicants.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient. Opens with purpose. Direct eye contact. No wasted breath. Business-like clarity without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。我が社が信頼される所以を整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll lay out what makes our company trustworthy.
lines.style: Attentive, ready to deliver. Slight nod on the opening. Steady voice. Confirming understanding before moving forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 独禁法の最新動向を社内で共有しましょう
lines.en: We should share the latest antitrust updates with the team.
lines.style: Clear directive. Even tone. Slight emphasis on 'should'—not asking, guiding. Measured pace, purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務両氏に確認を取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll check with the legal team.
lines.style: Clipped acknowledgment. Quick confirmation. Businesslike rhythm. Ready to execute the next step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 論文所収の業界誌を社員に推奨しましょう
lines.en: Let's recommend the industry journal articles to the staff.
lines.style: Instructive, steady. Slight forward lean in the voice. Professional warmth underneath. Building initiative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修をインタラクティブに変更します
lines.en: Yes. I'll restructure the training to be more interactive.
lines.style: Assured and responsive. Small pause after 'Yes'—showing he's already thinking through the implementation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社外との送受信ルールを整備しましょう
lines.en: And we should formalize the external communication guidelines.
lines.style: Conclusive tone. Slight buildup—this is the final item. Clear and settled. Leadership voice without strain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新キャンペーンのキャッチフレーズ案を集めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll gather tagline ideas for the new campaign.
lines.style: Closing beat. Energy shifts slightly lighter—toward creative work. Still professional, but warmer. Finishing strong.
